bands.label: the research line — confirmation still required

notes: The penalties can outweigh everything. A stock can score full marks on all five positives and still fail, because the four penalties are worth more (−14) than the five positives are (+13). That is deliberate: the scanner is built to find things before they move, so a name that has already run is penalised harder than good news can reward it. Most days nothing qualifies — and that is the scanner working, not failing.

Scoring rules are fixed in the research playbook and are not changed to fit a result. Nothing here is investment advice or a prediction — every signal is tracked afterwards in the marked-to-market ledger below, including the ones that went wrong.

action.label: Action now
action.decision: SAUD only after accretion and confirmation; reject ATLC at this gap
reasoning: The FRA approved publication of SAUD’s mandatory share-swap offer for up to 329,471,871 ATLC shares, reaching up to 90% with a 51% minimum. At the saved 0.1919 SAUD-share ratio, the live SAUD price implied EGP 4.4905 per ATLC share; ATLC’s EGP 5.53 was 23.15% above it. SAUD itself remained below EGP 23.62 and had only about EGP 17.8m versus the EGP 30m gate.

action.label: Action now
action.decision: Do not chase; wait for the completed close
reasoning: The live print was about 23.86% above the strict five-session reference, partial volume was only about 2.65× the saved preceding-20 median and close strength was about 60.5%. All three fail the saved gates despite strong value. Bid/ask was EGP 11.36/11.37, but acceptable spread cannot override anti-chasing or confirmation failure.
